verdict.rationale: Morph documents OpenAI-SDK and Anthropic-Messages-API compatibility (point any OpenAI SDK at api.morphllm.com, native /v1/messages for Claude Code) plus an MCP server, giving developers standard, well-documented ways to integrate — one community user (goose author) confirms real usage. However there's no evidence of a dedicated first-party Morph SDK package (npm/pip) beyond compatibility with generic OpenAI/Anthropic clients, and one hands-on report noted odd/unexpected model output when using the apply endpoint. Missing for 10: a dedicated official Morph client library, and broader independent corroboration of SDK reliability beyond a single HN thread.
